external_collaboration.evidence_quote: SICPA SA, a technology company based in Switzerland, announced Monday that it would expand its partnership with UbiQD to commercialize more quantum dot products in anti-counterfeit security inks. Quantum dots are a type of semiconductor nanoparticle technology that absorb one color of light and then convert it into a different color.

SICPA has partnered with governments, central banks and high-security printers as customers of its security ink products. Headquartered in Switzerland, it also has a U.S. subsidiary, SICPA US, which has a subsidiary based in Albuquerque, STA Technologies, located at 5401 Venice Ave. SICPA has around 3,000 employees.
